metadata.description: Actian Design System toolkit for Claude: four skills that read the Actian design system knowledge (vendored) and hand over what the product team uses: a proposal and intent.md, a clickable prototype and its Figma push, an audit with fixes and specs.md. WCAG 2.2 AA.

plugins.name: actian-design-system
plugins.description: Skills: actian-ux (questions and UX policy), actian-ux-proposal (proposal document and intent.md), actian-ux-prototype (clickable prototype, Figma push), actian-ux-audit (audit, fixes, specs.md). No agents. Knowledge vendored from volivarii/actian-ds-knowledge.
